stories_kpis.name: Closing of Skydance and Paramount Global Merger Transaction
stories_kpis.explanation: Closing of the merger transaction combining Paramount Global and Skydance Media into Paramount Skydance Corporation
stories_kpis.description: On August 7, 2025, the transaction closed creating Paramount Skydance Corporation following the acquisition of National Amusements, Inc. by entities controlled by the Ellison family and RedBird Capital Partners. This merger established a new accounting basis through pushdown accounting.

ai_positioning.summary: The company PSKY does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related topics in its 10-K/20-F report for the 2025 fiscal year. No information is available regarding any potential strategy, use, or risks related to AI.

risks.title: Uncertainty regarding the acquisition of Warner Bros.
risks.summary: The public tender offer for Warner Bros. faces significant regulatory and competitive hurdles, with a high risk of failure despite strengthened conditions and financing commitments.
risks.score_rationale: Central position in the 10-K with multiple recent amendments (February 2026) and personal guarantee from Lawrence Ellison. Intensified language on conditions precedent, rising fees, and risk of non-closing. Major exposure in case of transaction failure.

risks.title: Dependence on the Ellison family
risks.summary: The company is controlled by the Ellison family, which concentrates strategic decision-making and exposes it to corporate governance risks.
risks.score_rationale: Discussed in Item 1 and Item 7 of the 10-K, the Ellison family holds de facto control through National Amusements, Inc. Language asserts near-total control, reinforced by Lawrence Ellison's personal guarantee for Warner Bros. financing. Existential risk in case of strategic divergence.

risks.title: Post-merger integration complexity
risks.summary: The integration of Paramount Global and Skydance Media under a new accounting framework creates risks of operational, financial, and systems misalignment.
risks.score_rationale: Disclosed in Item 1A of the 10-K with pushdown accounting applied since August 7, 2025. Explicit mention of the lack of comparability of financial results. Moderate intensity but sensitive context due to a recent merger involving Paramount Global and Skydance Media.

risks.title: Cybersecurity and Data Protection
risks.summary: The company acknowledges major risks related to cyberattacks, business continuity, and the protection of personal data of users on its platforms.
risks.score_rationale: First risk listed in Item 1A of the 10-K prior to financial matters. Strategic positioning in the document indicating management priority. Language acknowledging significant vulnerabilities related to cyberattacks and personal data protection.

risks.title: Risque de rupture contractuelle post-transaction
risks.summary: The potential failure to obtain contractual consents following the merger could lead to disruptions with certain partners or counterparties of key contracts.
risks.score_rationale: Identified risk following the Transactions of August 7, 2025. Certain contracts may require third-party consents or include change of control clauses. Moderate warning language, but post-merger context increases relative vulnerability.

risks.title: Potential dilution related to PIPE warrants
risks.summary: The financing structure of the transaction could include optional instruments generating potential dilution for existing shareholders.
risks.score_rationale: Implicitly mentioned in the context of Skydance transaction's financing structure. Factual risk but dependent on optional exercise and stock price performance. Low weighting as the risk is conditional.
